agents.help.summary: Read and define the scope's agents and skills
agents.help.detail:
deckent agents [--scope <id>] [--json]
  Lists the scope's agents, most recently changed first.
deckent agents inspect <agent-id> [--scope <id>] [--json]
  Shows one agent: persona, WorkClasses, pinned skills, manager and every revision.
deckent agents skills [--scope <id>] [--json]
  Lists the scope's skills with their source and pin.
deckent agents skill <skill-id> [--scope <id>] [--json]
  Shows one skill with its text, pin and every revision.
deckent agents define --input <file> [--scope <id>]
  Creates or revises the agent in the JSON file (agentId, name, persona, workClasses, skills, parentAgentId).
deckent agents define-skill --input <file> [--scope <id>]
  Creates or revises your own skill from the JSON file (skillId, name, text).
  define, define-skill and import-skill: --example prints a filled file (and this installation's WorkClasses), --schema every field.
Define and define-skill run only on your own terminal, each on one card; AI tools, pipes and --json are refused. An agent carries requirements only: the system assigns the model, and the tier stays empty. Skills are pinned by their content digest; a skill from elsewhere is imported only when it is pinned and signed by a trusted key.

agents.help.action.skill: show one skill with its history
agents.help.action.define: create or revise an agent from a JSON file (a person's card)
agents.help.action.define-skill: create or revise your own skill from a JSON file (a person's card)

error.AGENT_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE: The agent catalog, its policy or its integrity key is unavailable.
error.AGENT_CATALOG_CORRUPT: An agent catalog record failed its integrity checks.
error.AGENT_CATALOG_COMMAND_CONFLICT: This command id was already used for a different catalog change.
error.AGENT_CATALOG_REVISION_CONFLICT: The definition changed since it was read; read it again and retry with its current revision.
error.AGENT_CATALOG_NOT_FOUND: No such agent or skill in this scope.
error.AGENT_CATALOG_EXISTS: An agent or skill with this id already exists in this scope; revise it instead.
error.AGENT_CATALOG_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The catalog change may or may not have been saved; retry the same command id to learn its outcome.
error.AGENT_CATALOG_LIMIT: This scope already holds the most agents its limits allow.
error.AGENT_DEFINITION_INVALID: The agent definition is invalid or above its limits (an agent names requirements only, never a model).
error.SKILL_DEFINITION_INVALID: The skill definition is invalid or above its limits.
error.AGENT_ORG_CYCLE: An agent cannot report to itself, directly or through other agents.
error.AGENT_ORG_DEPTH: The reporting chain would be deeper than the org tree allows.
error.AGENT_PARENT_NOT_FOUND: The manager agent does not exist in this scope.
error.AGENT_SKILL_NOT_PINNED: A skill is not an exact saved revision of this scope with that pin.
error.AGENT_WORK_CLASS_UNKNOWN: A WorkClass is not in this installation's registry.
error.SKILL_IMPORT_UNPINNED: Refused: a skill from elsewhere must name its content digest (pin).
error.SKILL_IMPORT_PIN_MISMATCH: Refused: the skill's content does not match its pin.
error.SKILL_IMPORT_UNSIGNED: Refused: a skill from elsewhere must be signed.
error.SKILL_IMPORT_SIGNATURE_UNVERIFIED: Refused: the skill's signature could not be verified against a trusted key for exactly this content.
error.AGENT_PROMPT_TOO_LARGE: The agent's persona and pinned skills do not fit the worker prompt next to the task. Nothing was saved or run, and no other agent was chosen. Shorten the persona or pin fewer or shorter skills.
error.AGENT_STANDING_REFUSED: That agent standing change is not allowed from its current standing or by this principal. Nothing was changed.
error.AGENT_STANDING_CONFLICT: The agent's standing changed since it was shown. Nothing was changed; look at it again and decide on the current standing.
agents.inspect.standingNone: Standing per work class: none recorded (defined before standings existed; revise the agent to open them)
agent.policyTurn.auditFailed: The turn’s policy audit record could not be saved (policy-turn). Decisions and completed effects are unchanged; inspect the service audit store with deckent doctor.
error.AGENT_WORK_CLASS_UNKNOWN.known: A WorkClass is not in this installation's registry. Use one of: {known}. Example: deckent agents define --example
